Listening 1 Vocabulary Note
今日の重要語彙を確認しましょう。
redo
To do something again, or to decorate a room in a new way.
やり直す、改装する
be supposed to ~
To be planned or expected to ~ (but often it did not happen).
～することになっている（はずだった）
Fair enough.
Used to accept that something is reasonable.
それなら仕方ないね、なるほどね
handle
To take care of a job or a problem.
担当する、対処する
safety inspector
A person whose job is to check that a place is safe.
安全検査官

Listening 2 — Answer the Questions (in class)
Mai's presentation: "My Hometown"

Listening 2 Vocabulary Note
be designated as ~
To be officially chosen or named as ~.
～に指定される
National Treasure
Something officially protected by the government because it is very important.
国宝
tear down
To destroy a building on purpose.
取り壊す
raise money
To collect money from people for a purpose.
資金を集める、募金する
turn A into B
To change A so that it becomes B.
AをBに変える

Dialogue Practice — Ondoku
オーディオを聞いて、繰り返し音読練習をしましょう。ハイライト語句にカーソルを当てると日本語が表示されます。
DIALOGUE AUDIO
Aileen & Charlotte — Bridge
Aileen
Charlotte! You look like you've just won the lottery. What's going on?
Charlotte
Almost as good! My article on Onomichi has been picked up by a major travel magazine.
Aileen
No way! Congratulations! How did that happen?
Charlotte
Apparently, it was shared online by one of their editors, and I was contacted the next day. They've even asked me to write a monthly column.
Aileen
That's huge! Will you be paid per article?
Charlotte
Yes, and pretty well, actually. The only catch is that everything has to be approved by the chief editor before it goes out.
Aileen
Hmm, that could be a bit frustrating.
Charlotte
Tell me about it. I'm not used to being told what to cut. But I guess it's part of the deal.
Aileen
Exactly — and it's a great opportunity. Let's celebrate. Dinner's on me tonight!
Charlotte
You don't have to do that! ...Well, if you insist. Thank you, Aileen!
EXPRESSIONS EXPLANATION
be picked up by ~
To be chosen and used by a magazine, TV show, company, etc.
（メディアなどに）取り上げられる
Apparently, ~
Used to say what you have heard, when you are not 100% sure.
どうやら～らしい
The only catch is ~
The only problem or bad point of a good thing is ~.
唯一の難点は～だ
Tell me about it.
I completely agree (often about something annoying).
本当にそうなの、まったくだよ
part of the deal
Something you have to accept as part of a situation.
（引き受けた以上）仕方のないこと
if you insist
Used to accept an offer politely after first saying no.
そこまで言うなら（お言葉に甘えて）

Express Yourself — Free Writing
会話のアイデアを英語で書いてみましょう。
A friend notices something you have had for a long time — a watch, a bag, a piece of jewelry, a photo, or anything special to you. They ask about it. Tell them its story and why it still matters to you.
Think about the conversation you would have and write down your ideas below.
e.g. This watch was given to me by my grandfather when I got my first job.
e.g. It's been repaired twice, but it still keeps perfect time.
e.g. I'd hate to think it might be lost or stolen one day.
